_about: RemoteMouseFix Phase 1 - diagnostics only. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_target_process: Executable to observe, matched case-insensitively on the file name.
_diagnostic_mode: Must be true in Phase 1. This build contains no filtering and no input synthesis.
_log_mouse_moves: false records buttons, wheel and state transitions only, which keeps logs small.
_log_directory: Relative paths resolve next to RemoteMouseFix.exe.
_rotation: Roll over past max_log_bytes and keep at most max_log_files files.
_flush_on_button: Flush after every button event so a crash still keeps the interesting moment.
_jump_threshold_px: Tag a movement as JUMP once |dx| or |dy| reaches this many physical pixels.
_recenter_tolerance_px: An injected move landing this close to the client centre is tagged RECENTER.
_state_poll_interval_ms: Sampling period for cursor visibility and ClipCursor state.
_console_status_interval_ms: Live counter refresh in the console. 0 disables it.
_heartbeat_interval_ms: Periodic liveness line in the log. Proves the tool was watching even when no event was recorded. 0 disables it.
